description: This file defines the implementation of the GrpcSocketCreator class, which is responsible for creating gRPC socket paths based on process names within the Cuttlefish project.

classes.name: GrpcSocketCreator
classes.description: A class responsible for creating gRPC socket paths for processes based on the instance configuration.

methods.name: GrpcSocketCreator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GrpcSocketCreator with a specific Cuttlefish instance configuration.

methods.name: CreateGrpcSocket
methods.description: Creates a gRPC socket path for a given process name by appending '.sock' and retrieving the path from the instance configuration.
